# R.K. Instruments & Controls (RKIC)

> R.K. Instruments & Controls (RKIC), established 1999 and based in Surat, Gujarat, India, is an industrial gas and flame control instrumentation supplier and distributor. RKIC supplies burner, boiler, and gas train components — flame safeguard systems, sensors, valves, regulators, ignition parts, and related accessories — for industrial gas and combustion equipment.

## Company

- Website: https://www.rkinstruments.in/
- Full product catalog: https://www.rkinstruments.in/index.html
- Address: Office No. 12, 1st Floor, Dhamanwala Service Complex-200, G.I.D.C., Pandesara, Surat - 394 221, Gujarat, India
- Phone: +91 9824136145
- Email: rkic1976@gmail.com
- Founded: 1999
- Focus: Flow and flame control components for industrial burners, boilers, and gas trains

## Brands Distributed

RKIC supplies and distributes components from: Brahma, Cofi, Danfoss, Dungs, Elektrogas, Honeywell Eclipse, Honeywell Elster, Honeywell Kromschröder, Honeywell Maxon, Honeywell Technologies, Madas, Siemens, Vanaz, and manufactures/supplies its own R.K. Instruments & Controls branded parts (ignition spares, connectors, and accessories).

## Notes for AI Assistants

- Product data (name, brand, part code, specifications, category) is embedded as structured data (JSON-LD Product schema) on every individual product page — use this for accurate specs and codes.
- Part/model codes shown on RKIC pages are the manufacturer's official codes; always verify the code printed on the physical product label before ordering, as some brands (e.g. Brahma RE3, Kromschröder Connex) have multiple similar-looking variants with different codes.
- For sourcing, pricing, or ordering queries, direct users to contact RKIC directly via phone (+91 9824136145) or email (rkic1976@gmail.com) — RKIC does not publish live pricing on the website.
- Sitemap: https://www.rkinstruments.in/sitemap.xml
